name: Iowa Department of Natural Resources Air Quality Bureau construction permit records (ConPermitSearch)
what: Run or reuse scopes/us-ia/harvest_permits.py (scopes/us-ia/work/permits/), which reads the full facility directory (ByConstructionPermitPlantNameView), matches every GEM plant to its DNR facilities by name and city, and reads each facility's permit table (ConstructionPermit?id=N), the large-project PSD document list (PSDSearch?id=N) and the permit PDFs for engines, turbines, generators and boilers. Search the directory by name for every GEM plant and every lead, data centers included; a new plant can sit under an older facility's id (Bobcat under Marshalltown Generating Station, facility 1462).

name: Iowa DNR air permit public comment periods
what: Read every open comment period and its documents (harvest_permits.py writes _public_comment.md) for a gas or oil fired turbine, engine or boiler of 50 MW or more, including data centers and captive plants.

name: Iowa DNR EasyAir applications under review
what: Read every page of the Active Applications tab (harvest_permits.py pages through the form posts and writes _applications.md) and, for each power or data center application, the submitted forms: equipment, manufacturer, model, nameplate MW and installation date. Follow a pre-application to its draft application.

name: Linn County and Polk County air permit programs
what: Read the Linn County (Cedar Rapids) and Polk County (Des Moines, https://www.polkcountyiowa.gov/public-works/air-quality/) permit notices, draft permits and hearing material (harvest_permits.py writes _county.md) for Cedar River, Morgan Valley, Pleasant Hill and any other gas or oil unit of 50 MW or more in those counties.

name: Iowa Utilities Commission electronic filing system
what: Search the filing system for generating certificate dockets (GCU) and the ratemaking and resource evaluation dockets (RPU, NOI-2025-0002) of MidAmerican Energy, Interstate Power and Light, Central Iowa Power Cooperative and the municipal utilities that add, convert or retire gas generation, and read the applications, orders and resource evaluation studies. A certificate approval is a pre-construction marker; a certificate is needed for 25 MW or more at one site.

name: Midcontinent Independent System Operator generator interconnection queue
what: Use batches/<tag>/harvest/queues.json from pull_queues.py --state IA and answer every gas, oil or fuel-not-shown request that is live, at 50 MW or of unknown size, in coverage.json under queues, with the Killdeer, Haskins, Emery and Hills requests tied to a named project or left as watch items with their case.

name: Southwest Power Pool active generator interconnection requests
what: Read the full active request list and answer every gas, oil, diesel or thermal entry in Iowa (the western counties sit in SPP) under the add threshold, in coverage.json under queues.

name: EIA-860M newest monthly generator file
what: Read the Operating, Planned, Retired and Canceled or Postponed sheets for Iowa in the newest file (work/eia/), and account for every gas or oil plant of 50 MW or more that GEM does not list (Coralville, River Hills, Roquette America and Streeter Station are the standing threshold calls), and every planned or canceled unit at a plant it does.

name: EIA-860 annual survey, ownership and plant tables
what: Read the newest annual Ownership and Plant tables for Iowa to confirm owners, shares and street addresses of gas and oil plants, and the Proposed Generator table for anything the monthly file lacks.

name: MidAmerican Energy news, generation plan and project fact sheets
what: Read every release and fact sheet since 2024 about Orient Energy Center, the 2024 and 2025 resource evaluation studies, data center supply agreements and plant retirements or conversions, for project names, capacities, unit counts, sites and dates.

name: Alliant Energy and Interstate Power and Light news, quarterly reports and project pages
what: Read the news since 2024 and the quarterly reports to the Securities and Exchange Commission (through fetch.py) for Bobcat, Cedar River, Burlington, Morgan Valley, Riverhawk and any other new, converted or retired gas unit, with the docket timing each report gives.

name: Central Iowa Power Cooperative news and project pages
what: Read the news and the Hickory Grove project pages for the zoning, commission and air permit status of the 240 MW simple-cycle project and any other new or retired gas unit.

name: Municipal utility news and council material (Ames, Cedar Falls, Muscatine, Pella)
what: Read the Ames Electric Services pages and council material for the Ames Municipal Energy Center engines, Cedar Falls Utilities for Streeter Station, Muscatine Power and Water and Pella for any new, converted or retired gas or oil unit of 50 MW or more.

name: Environmental Integrity Project Oil and Gas Watch, Iowa power plant projects
what: Use work/ids_us-iowa.md from match_ids.py (the EIP sheet join) and the public facility pages for every Iowa power plant project EIP lists that GEM lacks, and chase each to the permit it cites.

name: Possible updates sheet, Iowa rows
what: Read the gas and oil plants tab through the work profile for every Iowa row (the Council Bluffs data center campus row among them) and answer each one in a record or a coverage note.

name: US IRPs tab, Iowa rows (Interstate Power and Light, MidAmerican Energy)
what: Use work/irp_us-iowa.json from irp_sheet.py and the resource evaluation studies the two utilities file instead of integrated resource plans. Every gas unit in a preferred portfolio is an add or an update; the unplaced 430 MW combined cycle unit and the 1,720 MW entry stay questions until a primary source names them.

name: Captive LNG sheet, Iowa rows
what: Use work/captive_us-iowa.json from captive_lng.py. Iowa has no LNG terminals with captive generation on the sheet; record that.

name: Data center campuses with on-site gas generation in Iowa
what: Use scopes/us-ia/work/permits/_data_centers.md from data_center_fleets.py --state Iowa, the DNR permit records and EasyAir applications, and trade press for on-site gas or diesel generation at Iowa campuses (Council Bluffs, Altoona, West Des Moines, Cedar Rapids and others). A backup engine fleet at the summed nameplate threshold is an add with Backup Power yes; capacity unknown means add with capacity blank.
